best_idea: A report should carry the reporter's own server-stamped window of heard lines, copied at filing time, attached only to harassment reports, with one open report per reporter.
decision_why: Keep the filing-time copy, harassment-only attachment and one-open-report guard; write the report as a writer row (one ledger), prune before copying, and drop the email and Discord transcript copies.
acceptance: A verbal-harassment report attaches only the reporter's server-stamped lines from the last 20 minutes; a second open report by the same player is refused; a stuck report has no attachment.
